content: {"phoneNote":"The hero card covers the whole photo so the house is never seen on the first screen, and the address, hours and directions are each repeated three times down the page.","desktopNote":"The hero photo and card work, but the whole-page capture shows the header duplicated with a dead band above it, and the footer repeats the address, hours and directions already given in the contact section.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Merge the contact section and footer: show address, directions and hours once; keep the big phone number as the single contact call to action.","On phone shrink the hero card or place it below the photo so the house and terrace are visible in the first screen; add a dish or interior photo near the tasting menus.","Tighten the '1990' / 'Kdaj nas lahko obiščete' block on desktop: the oversized year and heading leave a dead band on the right below the hours."],"blockers":["Desktop whole page: the header appears twice at the top with an empty white band above the first one and a photo strip between them.","Phone whole page: a bare photo strip sits above the header, duplicating the hero image before the real header starts.","Both viewports: address, 'Navodila za pot' and opening hours are repeated in the hours section, the contact section and the footer."]}
